svg.text: 1 Membrane 0.25 at the floor of the Ø14 x 1.5 nut recess: cut out to Ø7.5
2 Strip hole Ø8.0; knob Ø22 x 12 with 0.8 gap to the strip

The ZK-502C positions come from photos. Measure the board before production.
Joint details: volume control and AUX socket
